summary: Iteration 2 validates the admin user/class creation flow + new student onboarding (initial balance, login, role-based redirect). 14/14 backend pytest tests passed and full UI E2E flow passed end-to-end (admin login -> create student via form -> logout -> student login -> /aluno with balance 75 visible -> cleanup).
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_credentials=False but backend sets httpOnly access_token cookie on login -- frontend currently uses Bearer header (from /auth.js axios default), so cookie is unused. Either set allow_credentials=True with explicit origins to fully use cookie-based auth, or stop setting the cookie. Functionally OK today because token is in body and used as Bearer.
No brute-force lockout implemented on /api/auth/login (playbook requirement). Consider adding rate limiting / failed-attempt counter.

seed_data is idempotent on existence-by-email but DOES NOT update admin password if ADMIN_PASSWORD env changes (playbook says seed_admin should update existing admin if password changed). Currently admin password is locked to first seed.
server.py is ~665 lines and growing — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, admin.py, teacher.py, student.py) for maintainability.
/api/admin/users response leaks password_hash protection only via projection; consistent. Good.
EmailStr validator is used (good), and bcrypt hash verified as $2b$12$ prefix in DB.
test_credentials: admin@arcoins.edu / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md was empty; using values from backend/.env ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD)
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed; test users/classes created during the run were cleaned up via DELETE and MongoDB cleanup script. Final DB state: 11 seed users + 2 seed classes (unchanged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All admin user/class creation flows (POST /api/admin/users, /api/admin/classes), student onboarding (initial_balance creates 'Saldo inicial de boas-vindas' transaction), validation errors (duplicate email, short password, invalid class_id, cannot delete self), and JWT reuse are working. UI testids confirmed: create-user-form, role-student/teacher/admin, new-name/email/password/class/balance, create-user-btn, user-msg, users-list, remove-{email}, create-class-form, class-name, create-class-btn. Frontend uses Bearer token (Authorization header) — cookie is set but not used by frontend. CORS allow_credentials=False is acceptable for current Bearer approach.
